title: Fresh Tzatziki Sauce
description: The whole trick is wringing the cucumber genuinely dry — skip it and you get soup.

ingredients.note: grated on the large holes of a box grater, then wrung dry

steps.text: Grate half an English cucumber on the large holes of a box grater.
Gather the grated cucumber into a clean kitchen towel or strong paper towels and squeeze hard to wring out all the internal water.
In a bowl, combine the dry squeezed cucumber, Greek yogurt, pressed garlic, lemon juice, olive oil, finely chopped dill and salt.
Stir well, cover, and store in the refrigerator until ready to serve.

notes: Make this early — it is better after an hour in the fridge for the flavours to marry.
